name: Plainstrider Talon
summary: Across Mulgore, tauren shamans gather Plainstrider Talon for cleansing totems. The sharp claws come from large, flightless plainstriders native to the region, and help cleanse corrupted water.

sections.title: Bonds of the Plains
sections.body: Large, flightless plainstriders roam Mulgore’s open grasses, using powerful legs and sharp claws to forage through tough prairie earth and defend against predators. To the tauren of Bloodhoof Village, every part of a hunted beast carries spiritual resonance. When goblin ventures tainted sacred sources such as the Winterhoof Water Well, shaman Mull Thunderhorn sought plainstrider talons alongside prairie wolf paws. In tauren ritual crafting, reagents from native predators and foragers channel the land’s spiritual essence into totems that can purge unnatural poisons.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Plainstrider Talon?
faq.answer: Adult plainstriders, elder plainstriders, and the notorious strider Mazzranache yield Plainstrider Talons across Mulgore’s grasslands.

faq.q: What are Plainstrider Talons used for?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village needs plainstrider talons and prairie wolf paws to craft a cleansing totem for purifying the corrupted Winterhoof Water Well.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need animal parts to clean the water?
faq.answer: Tauren shamanism relies on harmony with Mulgore’s natural spirits. Binding local wildlife into a ritual totem calls on the land’s raw power to fight unnatural pollutants introduced by Venture Company goblins.

faq.q: Who poisoned the water wells in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Agents of the Venture Company operating in Mulgore, along with their lackeys, tainted the sacred tribal water wells. Their acts disrupt the local environment and threaten the tauren tribes.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see how tauren rituals use beasts’ physical parts, such as talons, to make purifying totems and draw power from the land’s native spirits.
As a tauren, you honor the sacrifice of Mulgore’s wildlife through the hunt. Every beast taken helps heal the Earth Mother when goblin exploitation strikes.
